mode_inference_decision.rationale: Opaque authored 3D geometry with offline CC0 texture maps; no 2D UI cutout or chroma key.

source_review.modeling: Existing user authorization to use their 3D modeling software remains in force.
source_review.textures: Five Poly Haven CC0 sources reviewed against official asset pages and license; original maps, hashes and URLs retained in texture-sources.json.

visual_targets: Sand-colored old-town architecture with enclosed streets, doors, balconies, awnings and distinct A/B landmarks
PBR color, normal and roughness on major wall/ground/wood/metal surfaces, at least 256 pixels per meter
Human-proportioned 1.8m soldiers with restrained tactical colors and limited team patches
Recognizable pistol/SMG/carbine/sniper silhouettes and anatomically plausible gloved first-person hands
Readable directional shadows, cool sky fill, contact shading and preserved sky detail
geometry_contract: Y-up GLB, ground XZ, forward -Z; collision geometry must agree with map-data.json; decorative detail must remain outside walkable clearances.
alpha_policy: Opaque 3D materials, alpha only if needed for a specifically recorded fence/cloth asset.
functional_hud_exception: The scope aperture and reticle are CSS geometry aligned to the camera ray, not a generated art asset. No localizable text is baked into the scope or card.
revision_scope: User requested additional realistic details and substantial runtime performance improvement. Preserve single-player rules and collision footprints.
